Dominating the center is an enormous great white shark erupting vertically from a blood-red ocean, its cavernous mouth stretched impossibly wide and packed with oversized razor-sharp teeth. The shark's glaring red-ringed eye and splashes of crimson water amplify the over-the-top horror aesthetic. In the foreground, a terrified swimmer reaches desperately toward the viewer, eyes bulging and mouth frozen in a scream as the churning scarlet sea threatens to swallow him.
